The U.S. men's national team looks to make it two wins from two in the post-World Cup era on Tuesday, Sept. 29, as it hosts Chile in St. Louis. In a match that saw 11 players earn their first caps, the USMNT beat Peru 4-1 in Orlando on Saturday, Sept. Two of those debutants, Justin Ellis and Julian Hall, scored in their first USMNT match, while Malik Tillman and Sebastian Berhalter also found the net. With a quick turnaround and two more games after the Chile match, Mauricio Pochettino will likely opt for a healthy amount of rotation on Tuesday at Energizer Park. data.title: Portugal XI vs Norway – Predicted lineup and team news - Yahoo Sports
data.content: # Portugal XI vs Norway – Predicted lineup and team news. **On Sunday,** **Portugal** **and** **Norway** **face off in their second UEFA Nations League group-stage meeting at Oslo's Ullevaal Stadion.**. Portugal come into this fixture with a winning start to their Nations League campaign but show uneven form overall. ## Portugal team news. Left-back Nuno Mendes is dealing with late muscle fatigue picked up in the Wales win, but medical staff expect him to be available for selection. He is likely to be supported on the flanks by João Félix, who keeps his place after scoring the decisive goal in the 1-0 victory over Wales. ## Portugal predicted lineup. ## When will the match kick off? The match will kick off at 7:45pm BST on Sunday, 27th September. In the United Kingdom, the Norway vs Portugal UEFA Nations League group match will be streamed live online via Amazon Prime Video.

data.title: Recent Match Report - Hong Kong vs Malaysia, Asian Games Men's Cricket Competition 2026, 2nd Match, Group B - ESPN
data.content: 2nd Match, Group B, Asian Games Men's Cricket Competition at Nisshin, Sep 24 2026. ***Malaysia** 84 for 2 (Syahadat 36\*, Virandeep 32\*, Rana 2-23) beat **Hong Kong** 81 for 9 (Mathur 29, Pavandeep 3-11, Amir 3-12) by eight wickets*. The left-arm spin pair of Pavandeep Singh and Muhammad Amir put a stranglehold on the Hong Kong batters in their Group B match at the Asian Games men's cricket competition, handing Malaysia a comfortable eight-wicket victory. An unbeaten 70-run partnership between Muhamad Syahadat and Virandeep Singh sealed the chase of 82 with eight overs to spare. With four of their top six batters not troubling the scorers, Hong Kong limped to 81 for 9 in 20 overs.
